title: AC1032 TABLECONTENT bounded raw-only shell recovery

source.provenance: Tracked external ACadSharp sample; used read-only, not copied into this repository.

authority.oda: ODA v5.4.1 §2 requires R2007+ object Unicode strings in the detached string stream; §20.4.99 describes TABLECONTENT value strings as TV. The peer's body-byte-count interpretation remains unreconciled.
authority.implementationPolicy: Do not change TABLECONTENT field parsing or infer semantic values. Preserve only the common shell and exact raw frame when the typed parser fails and RawObjectShell validates.

implementation.behavior: For only AC1032 TABLECONTENT / AcDbTableContent, a failed typed-body parse may publish raw-only after an independent RawObjectShell validates the common header and handle tail. The raw carrier has typedPayloadValidated=false and no TableContent callback is sent. An invalid shell remains failed. Strict output remains blocked by the raw-object/context replay gates.

coverage: raw-only publication occurs only after AC1032 shell validation
the full source payload, class identity and common owner/reactor roles are retained
no typed TABLECONTENT callback is sent for the raw-only source
a following typed associative object still publishes
the generated body is deliberately not a TABLECONTENT schema vector

physicalRead.result: Read completed; CLI returned 1 because strict DXF preparation correctly refused the existing standalone OBJECTCONTEXTDATA replay gate.

verification.fixturePolicy: No DWG or DXF fixture was added; the regression control is generated in memory.

scopeLimit: This closes raw frame publication for the two current AC1032 TABLECONTENT objects only. It does not resolve the body/string carrier dispute, recover typed cell values, establish output support, qualify other versions or producers, or establish native TABLE rendering.
